review_summary: The differential captures the core problem (uncontrolled hypertension) and major modifiers (OSA, metabolic syndrome, early CKD). Probability weighting needs adjustment—essential hypertension, metabolic syndrome, and CKD should be given higher likelihoods. The platelet distribution width abnormality is noted but not adequately explained; a reactive cause should be explored before invoking a myeloproliferative disorder. Important contextual diagnoses (hypertensive heart disease, resistant hypertension, psychosocial stressors) are missing. Overall reasoning quality is acceptable but requires refined probability allocation and additional work‑up recommendations.
